say:1:1130237001:1.text: Yes, the arena has scheduled many solo and team battles for competitors recently.
say:1:1130237001:1.source_cn: 是的，武斗场在近期安排了很多场角斗士单人对战和团队对战。

say:2:1130237002:1.text: The purpose of these skirmishes is to entertain and engage the audience in the spirit of the Warsong Festival.
say:2:1130237002:1.source_cn: 这些对战属于表演性质，主要目的是让大家更沉浸于战歌节的气氛。

say:3:1130237003:1.text: Guests can choose to wager on their favorite warriors or partake themselves.
say:3:1130237003:1.source_cn: 客人可以选择下注自己喜欢的勇士，也可以直接参与到对战中。
